articles.title: Robinhood rolls out public blockchain as it expands deeper into crypto
articles.snippet: Robinhood's product push continues to blur the line between crypto and more traditional finance.

articles.title: Ethereum Foundation lays out use cases for governments, institutions in new policy guide
articles.snippet: The Ethereum Foundation said policymakers should distinguish between decentralized public blockchains and networks that remain controlled by corporations or foundations, arguing that governance structures will play a critical role in determining which platforms are suitable for long-term public sector use.

articles.title: Ethereum backers launch nonprofit to lead institutional adoption efforts
articles.snippet: Backed by Joe Lubin, BitMine and SharpLink, the independent organization will serve as a liaison for financial institutions exploring Ethereum as competition for institutional capital heats up.

articles.title: Bitmine Ether buys eclipsed by $345M ETH ETF outflows: Is sub $1.5K next?
articles.snippet: Tokenization and RWA TVL growth highlight Ethereum’s fundamentals, but stagnant DApps and spot ETF outflows keep the pressure on ETH price.

articles.title: SEC seeks public comment on regulating next generation of ETFs
articles.snippet: The request from the US agency seeks feedback on how emerging ETF structures and investment strategies should be regulated as issuers roll out increasingly specialized products.
